terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
Last updated: November 2026.

These terms govern use of the Mali Ustvarjalci online store (the “store”) and purchases made through the website.

{{operator}}

You place an order via the cart and checkout. The purchase contract is concluded when we confirm acceptance of your order (for example by email or in your account). We may refuse an order (for example in case of suspected abuse, failed payment, or unavailability).

Prices are in euros (EUR). {{vatStatement}} Delivery costs are shown before you complete checkout. Payment is made using the methods available at checkout.

Delivery times and methods are indicated on the product or in the order confirmation. If a product is out of stock, we will notify you and offer an alternative or a refund.

As a consumer, you have a statutory right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days of receiving the goods (see our Returns policy). This right does not apply to products excluded by law (for example sealed hygiene products after opening), where clearly indicated.

Warranty and complaints are handled in accordance with applicable Slovenian consumer law. If a product is faulty, contact us at the email above with a description and, where useful, a photo.

Our liability is limited to the purchase amount unless the law requires otherwise. We are not liable for damage from misuse of products; parents and guardians are responsible for children’s safety when using toys and materials in line with the manufacturer’s instructions.

We may change these terms. The version published when you place your order applies to that order.

Disputes are governed by the laws of the Republic of Slovenia. The competent courts of Slovenia have jurisdiction.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Last updated: November 2026.

This policy explains how Mali Ustvarjalci processes personal data when you visit the online store and make a purchase, in line with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Slovenian Personal Data Protection Act (ZVOP-2).

{{operator}}

Privacy contact: {{privacyEmail}}.

Data we process: identification and contact details (name, surname, address, email, phone), order and payment data, technical visit data (e.g. IP address, browser type), and information you voluntarily send us (email messages).

Purposes and legal bases: performing your order and contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); legal obligations such as accounting and VAT (Art. 6(1)(c)); legitimate interests in system security, fraud prevention, and improving our services (Art. 6(1)(f)); where applicable, your consent for optional newsletters or analytics (Art. 6(1)(a)).

Cookies: we use strictly necessary cookies and, if you accept, other types as described in our Cookie policy.

Retention: we keep data only as long as needed for the purpose and as required by law (e.g. invoicing records).

Sharing: we may share data with payment providers, delivery partners, hosting providers, and other processors bound by appropriate data processing agreements. If data is transferred outside the EEA, we use appropriate safeguards under the GDPR.

Your rights: access, rectification, erasure (within legal limits), restriction, data portability (where applicable), objection to processing based on legitimate interests, and withdrawal of consent where processing relies on it. You may lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner of the Republic of Slovenia (https://www.ip-rs.si).

Security: we use appropriate technical and organisational measures against unauthorised access and loss of data.

returns.title: Returns Policy
returns.body:
Right of withdrawal (consumers)

If you buy as a consumer, under the Slovenian Consumer Protection Act (ZVPot) you may withdraw from a distance contract without giving a reason within 14 days of the day on which you physically receive the goods, or from the day the last part of the shipment is received by a third party at your direction.

How to withdraw: notify us with a clear statement (e.g. email to {{contactEmail}}) before the deadline. You may use a withdrawal form if we offer one, but it is not mandatory. Return the goods without undue delay and no later than 14 days after notifying us, unless we offer to collect them.

Return conditions: goods should be in unchanged quantity and condition, in original packaging where reasonable, with all enclosed documentation. The right of withdrawal does not apply to products excluded by law (e.g. hygiene products after opening if the seal is broken), as we inform you at purchase.

Return costs: you normally bear the cost of returning the goods unless agreed otherwise or the fault is ours.

Refunds: we refund all payments received as soon as possible and no later than 14 days from receiving your withdrawal notice, unless we have not yet received the goods—then after we receive the goods or proof that you have sent them back. We refund using the same payment method unless we agree otherwise in writing.

Complaints and defects under warranty are handled separately under warranty terms and law; they are not the same as the 14-day withdrawal right.

Returns address: {{returnsAddress}}

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body:
What are cookies

Cookies are small files stored on your device by the browser. They enable the site to work, save settings, or collect aggregated statistics.

Cookies we use

Strictly necessary cookies: required for basic site operation (e.g. cart, language settings, security). They are used on the basis of legitimate interest or because they are essential for the service you request.

Functional and analytics cookies: improve your experience or help us understand visits. Some load only if you choose “Accept” on the cookie banner, where implemented.

Marketing

If we introduce advertising cookies in the future, we will inform you separately and obtain consent where required by law.

Managing and refusing cookies

You can delete or restrict cookies in your browser settings. Disabling strictly necessary cookies may limit store functionality.

Contact: {{contactEmail}}.
